kept.reason: The pattern doc behind LLM-maintained markdown knowledge bases, presented as an alternative to RAG. It's the closest reference point for your approach.

kept.name: agentic-memory-benchmark
kept.reason: Benchmark of 8 agent memory systems in which a plain curated markdown wiki beat the commercial memory products. Direct evidence for comparing your design.

kept.name: sira
kept.reason: Improves BM25 lexical retrieval using LLM document enrichment, query expansion and reranking. A strong option to try alongside or before adding embeddings.

kept.name: repowise
kept.reason: Local codebase-intelligence engine for coding agents that combines a deterministic graph, a generated wiki and hybrid search with embeddings. Very close to your architecture.

kept.name: embeddinggemma-2
kept.reason: Candidate embedding model for your semantic layer: on-device, handles code and text, 8K context, Matryoshka truncation to smaller dimensions, Apache 2.0.

kept.reason: Google spec for agent-friendly knowledge as Markdown plus YAML frontmatter, with provenance and freshness signals and a graph viewer. A useful comparison for your typed records.

kept.name: graphify
kept.reason: Earlier inspiration for the kb graph. Its confidence-tagged edges and clustering could apply to your deterministic link graph.

kept.name: third-brain-v5-wiki
kept.reason: Wiki/knowledge layer with staleness and contradiction detection, ideas worth borrowing for keeping memory records healthy.

kept.name: mex
kept.reason: Structured markdown scaffold for persistent agent memory with drift-detection checks. An overlapping approach to compare against.

kept.name: chunkless-rag
kept.reason: RAG that walks document structure instead of retrieving fixed-size chunks. Comparable to navigating linked records rather than doing pure vector retrieval.

kept.name: claude-cookbook
kept.reason: Anthropic's official guides covering RAG, agent memory and context retrieval patterns, useful as a baseline when comparing.

kept.name: cartographer
kept.reason: Indexes a repo into a local SQLite graph that gives coding agents bounded briefs and evidence-backed notes. A similar deterministic-graph approach.

kept.name: memstack
kept.reason: Claude Code memory system using SQLite with semantic/vector search. A comparable design, though it was flagged for supply-chain caution.

kept.name: obsidian-claude-second-brain-workflow
kept.reason: Practitioner workflow that builds a typed, wikilinked markdown knowledge base with Claude Code. Shows a similar structure in practice.

kept.name: context-graphs-trillion-dollar-elephant
kept.reason: Covers the hard parts of context and memory graphs (forgetting, canonicalization, time, storage), lessons that apply to your graph.

kept.name: mmeb-benchmark
kept.reason: Embedding benchmark that includes text retrieval and agent-focused retrieval tasks. Useful for choosing and evaluating your embedding model.

kept.name: prompt-assembly-cache-discipline
kept.reason: Says to put retrieved, per-query content at the end of the prompt to keep the KV cache, which applies to how recalled memories get injected.

kept.name: open-webui
kept.reason: Mature RAG setup with BM25 and vector hybrid retrieval over pgvector/Elasticsearch. A reference implementation of hybrid search.
